Question: Circles with centers \(P,\) \(Q\) and \(R,\) having radii \(1,\) \(2\) and \(3,\) respectively, lie on the same side of line \(l\) and are tangent to \(l\) at \(P',\) \(Q'\) and \(R',\) respectively, with \(Q'\) between \(P'\) and \(R'.\) The circle with center \(Q\) is externally tangent to each of the other two circles. What is the area of \(\triangle PQR?\)
